compatibilityConstraints.reason: eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-import and eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y do not declare ESLint 10 support.
typescript-eslint requires TypeScript <6.1.0; docs checks use the TypeScript compiler API.
The published Babel plugin declares Babel 7 support. Keep that contract while upgrading its development environment within 7.x.
Dedicated React 18 compatibility fixture; intentionally stays on React 18.
Upgrade within the existing package-manager major to preserve the workspace and release workflow.
Vitest 5 changed Assertion generic parameters; the current jest-dom 7 augmentation still targets the prior assertion interface. Vitest 4.1.12 contains the security fixes.

remainingAdvisories.title: deepmerge mergeObject() allows prototype poisoning of returned objects
minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification
remainingAdvisories.resolution: ESLint 9 uses the function-exporting minimatch 3 API; forcing minimatch 11 would break it. ESLint 10 is outside the supported peer ranges of the current lint plugins.

migrations: TypeScript 6: remove baseUrl, make paths relative, preserve docs absolute imports with an explicit mapping, enable esModuleInterop and declare Node/Vitest DOM types.
Vitest 4: use maxWorkers, type console spies explicitly, update deprecated assertions.
Vite 8: use Oxc JSX options and pre-transform standard decorators with esbuild until Oxc can lower them.
dnd-kit 0.5: pass constraint instances to PointerSensor and use preventActivation in keyboard sensor tests.
Keep immutable shadcn primitives intact through scoped lint configuration.
Changesets 3: explicitly retain versioning of private packages and disable their tags, preserving the Changesets 2 defaults.
